prompt: Create a detailed watercolor portrait on warm aged parchment paper of a handsome young native Indian man shown from the chest up, facing slightly left and looking downward with a warm, gentle closed-mouth smile. He has wavy, voluminous black hair with loose strands over the forehead, thick eyebrows, expressive downcast eyes, a straight nose, and a neatly trimmed soft stubble beard. Dress him in a traditional deep maroon cotton kurta with a short open collar and small buttons, rendered with translucent watercolor washes and subtle fabric folds. Place exactly two large vibrant red hibiscus flowers beside him on the right side: one near the upper right behind his head and one larger flower near the lower right foreground, both with dark centers and yellow stamens. Add green hibiscus leaves and stems around the flowers, with loose red and brown watercolor splashes blending into the background. Use fine ink-like sketch lines for hair, facial contours, flower veins, and decorative swirls, with realistic facial detail but painterly edges. The composition should feel romantic, elegant, and organic, with earthy beige paper texture, maroon and crimson paint blooms, soft shadows, no text, no watermark, and a vertical portrait orientation.

promptZh: 在温暖的陈旧羊皮纸上创作一幅精致的水彩肖像，描绘一位英俊的年轻 印度本土 男子。画面为半身像，他微微向左侧身，低头垂眸，嘴角带着温暖、柔和的微笑。他拥有一头浓密且略带波浪感的 黑色 头发，几缕碎发散落在额前，眉毛浓密，眼神深邃含蓄，鼻梁挺直，留着修剪整齐的短须。他身着一件传统的 深栗色 棉质库尔塔长衫，领口微开并带有小扣子，通过半透明的水彩渲染和细腻的褶皱表现出布料质感。在他的右侧放置两朵硕大鲜艳的红色木槿花：一朵位于右上角头部后方，另一朵较大的花朵位于右下角前景，花心深邃，花蕊呈黄色。在花朵周围点缀绿色的木槿叶和茎干，背景中融入随性的红色和棕色水彩泼墨效果。使用类似钢笔素描的细腻线条勾勒头发、面部轮廓、花瓣纹理及装饰性漩涡，面部细节写实，边缘则保留水彩画的笔触感。整体构图浪漫、优雅且富有有机感，呈现出大地色系的米色纸张质感，伴有栗色和深红色的颜料晕染，阴影柔和，无文字，无水印，采用竖版肖像构图。
